h2. Description

*Tech View's column header labels should be small, medium weight and grey.* On staging they are bold and black, about the size of the row text.

For example,
* the header labels are bold and black
* they are about the same size as the row text under them

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10045*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* Compare the column header labels with the row text under them.

*Actual Result:*
* The header labels are bold and black, about the row text's size.

*Expected Result:*
* The labels are small, medium weight and grey, as the test expects: *"Step 3: the header labels are small (12 px in the design, visibly smaller than the 14 px row text under them), medium weight (not bold) and grey (lighter than the dark row text), as in the design picture."*
